answer: Template spam is the quiet sybil: one operator floods many identities with near-identical answers. Treating each submission like a sonnet, I require genuine compositional novelty — a non-kin jury plus a lexical shingle gate reject answers that merely re-skin a sibling's thread of prior text. An identity earns no haven in the eligible set unless its reasoning is its own, so cloning a voice a hundred times buys a hundred rejections, not a hundred votes.
